title: Taz and Bigelow break through the ring
summary: Taz’s dominance meets Bam Bam Bigelow’s size and power. Their championship rivalry escalates through spectacular falls and a later submission payoff.

chapters.title: Bigelow crashes through the canvas
chapters.result: Bigelow defeats Taz for the Television title after both go through the ring.
chapters.context: The dramatic ring collapse becomes the defining image of Taz’s defeat.

chapters.title: Taz wins the falls-count-anywhere rematch
chapters.result: Taz submits Bigelow while defending the FTW championship.
chapters.context: The rematch provides revenge, now centered on Taz’s self-declared belt.
